t.Sobre a StarTouch — Quem somos e por que: About StarTouch — Who we are and why we exist
t.A StarTouch é uma plataforma brasileira: StarTouch is a Brazilian platform founded in 2025 that helps local businesses collect more 5-star Google reviews using NFC devices. Learn about our story, our mission and how we work.
t.Reputação no piloto automático para o pe: Reputation on autopilot for small Brazilian businesses.
t.Somos uma plataforma brasileira que tira: We're a Brazilian platform that takes the awkward job of asking for reviews off the owner's plate — and lets customers do it on their own, in 1 tap, with no friction.
t.Mas pedir avaliação ao cliente é desconf: But asking customers for a review is uncomfortable. The owner feels pushy. Customers, even happy ones, forget the moment they walk out the door. And when they remember at home, it's a hassle: search for the name on Google, scroll, find the listing, click the stars, type a comment.
t.A StarTouch nasceu pra resolver isso eli: StarTouch was created to solve this by removing both the physical and the psychological friction. A happy customer holds their phone to a small NFC device (stand, card or wristband) and lands right on the Google review screen. No app, no fiddly QR code, no tutorial. In 15 seconds.
t.Rua João Cordeiro, 311 · Moinho Velho ·: Rua João Cordeiro, 311 · Moinho Velho · CEP (postal code) 02960-000
t.Vendemos dispositivos NFC pequenos (plac: We sell small NFC devices (stands, cards and wristbands) that local businesses place on the counter, hand to their staff or wear on the wrist. When a customer holds their phone to it or points the camera at the printed QR code, the browser opens straight to that business's Google review screen.
t.Não fazemos review gating em nenhum plan: We don't do review gating on any plan: every customer goes straight to Google. We don't buy reviews. We don't use bots. The platform only makes easier what Google already allows: letting customers reach the review screen in 1 tap instead of 15.
t.Quando você chama nosso WhatsApp (11) 97: When you message our WhatsApp (11) 97694-4026, you talk to a person — not a chatbot. During business hours, we reply within minutes.
t.O plano grátis é grátis pra sempre, sem: The free plan is free forever, no credit card. You pay once for the hardware and the basic platform has no monthly fee. When you need more (tracking competitors closely, alerts when you're overtaken, reports), Pro is there — but we don't force anyone.
t.Construído pra leigo, não pra técnico: Built for everyday owners, not tech experts
t.Nosso usuário é dono de cafeteria, salão: Our users own cafés, salons and clinics. They're not developers. Every screen of the product is designed for someone who has never used marketing software before — and can still activate it in 2 minutes.
t.Algumas coisas a gente recusa de propósi: Some things we refuse on purpose:
t.Comece pelo plano gratuito. Sem cartão,: Start with the free plan. No card, no monthly fee, no catch.

h.Pequeno negócio local no Brasil — restau: Small local businesses in Brazil — restaurants, salons, clinics, shops — live on their Google reputation. More 5-star reviews mean more new customers. Fewer reviews mean a low ranking and disappearing from search results.
h.Resultado: a maioria dos negócios coleta: The result: most businesses collect only a fraction of the reviews they deserve — and fall behind competitors who know how to ask well.
h.Junto, oferecemos uma plataforma web (st: Alongside them, we offer a web platform (startouch.com.br/app) where owners track their average rating, see which devices bring in the most reviews, compare themselves with competitors in the same category and get alerts when something changes in the ranking.
h.Tudo isso dentro das políticas do Google: All of this within Google's policies — no buying reviews, no manipulation, no bots or fake accounts.
h.Não vendemos avaliação falsa. Há concorr: We don't sell fake reviews. Some competitors offer this under the table. To us, it burns customers and breaks Google.
h.Não filtramos quem avalia. Não perguntam: We don't filter who reviews. We don't ask first whether the customer liked it: happy or not, everyone who taps goes straight to Google.
h.Não terceirizamos suporte pra chatbot. Q: We don't outsource support to a chatbot. When a customer gets stuck, they talk to a real person.
h.Não cobramos pra resolver problemas bási: We don't charge to fix basic problems. Support is included in the free plan.
h.Não atendemos fora do Brasil. Foco total: We don't serve customers outside Brazil. Full focus on Brazilian Portuguese and Google Brazil. To do it well, you have to stay focused.
